answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate refundable cryptographic stakes before any node enters the digital harbor. While a free network invites endless phantom clones, requiring locked capital makes mass identity fabrication financially ruinous for an attacker. Without this economic friction, trust becomes a mere fable. By forcing every autonomous agent to post collateral that is slashed upon malicious collusion, the protocol watches the network like a falcon, ensuring that scaling an attack directly scales the adversary's guaranteed financial loss.
